title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and diffuses through a population in response to social influence, policies, information campaigns, and supply constraints, optionally coupled with epidemic dynamics to observe health impacts.

interactions.name: social_influence_on_adoption
interactions.description: Individuals update their mask-wearing decision based on neighbors' behaviors and norms on the social network.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities impose mandates; locations and individuals respond. Enforcement actions (spot checks, fines) influence compliance.

interactions.name: information_broadcast_and_update
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that alter perceived risk and trust; individuals update beliefs accordingly.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: Individuals acquire masks from retailers subject to price and stock availability; retailers restock based on rates and demand.

interactions.name: activity_and_exposure_at_locations
interactions.description: People visit locations per schedules; if epidemic dynamics are enabled, infection risk depends on contacts, ventilation, and mask usage.

interactions.name: household_norms_and_resource_sharing
interactions.description: Households influence member behavior and share mask resources, affecting adoption and continuity of use.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption reaches 50% for the first time.

metrics.name: mean_compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate while a mandate is active.

metrics.name: subgroup_adoption_gap
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between defined subgroups (e.g., income or age brackets).

metrics.name: masks_purchased
metrics.description: Cumulative number of masks acquired by the population.

metrics.name: stockout_events
metrics.description: Count of days/retailers where mask stock reached zero.

metrics.name: Rt
metrics.description: Effective reproduction number over time (only if epidemic dynamics are enabled).

metrics.name: incident_cases
metrics.description: New infections per day (only if epidemic dynamics are enabled).

metrics.name: peak_incidence
metrics.description: Maximum daily infections observed over the simulation (only if epidemic dynamics are enabled).

metrics.name: cumulative_infections_averted
metrics.description: Total infections avoided compared to a no-mask counterfactual (only if epidemic dynamics are enabled).
